description: A real flashlight for Minecraft — shader-driven light engine with volumetric beam, voxel shadows and blinding glare. Fabric 26.1.x, companion to Enhanced Darkness.

mods.name: Flashlight
mods.description: Ручные фонари для horror-паков: маленький фонарик и большой рабочий фонарь. Батарейки-расходники, перезарядка как reload у оружия, реальный свет, который останавливается о стены и влияет на спавн мобов.

releases.notes:
The light engine rebuilt. Real shadow maps, a beam shaped like an actual reflector, no more per-chunk light cap, and a settings screen to tune it all.

## Added

- **Real shadow maps.** Terrain is re-rendered from the flashlight's point of view into a depth atlas, so shadows follow the actual geometry: a slab casts a slab, stairs cast stairs, leaves cast a dappled mess. Reaches 64 blocks, where the old voxel grid stopped at 24. Soft edges come from a rotated PCF kernel — a kernel aligned to the texture axes would read as a staircase, because Minecraft walls are axis-aligned too.
- **Settings screen** (ModMenu → gear, or `config/flashlight.json`). Three tabs — Shadows, Beam, Night vision — applied live while you drag the slider.
- **Night vision sharpening.** An unsharp mask at tube-cell spacing draws a hard rim exactly one cell wide around every silhouette, so the low resolution is obvious the moment you put the goggles on. Plus scanlines, bloom around hot spots, and sensor grain that thickens as the battery dies.

## Changed

- **Beam shape: hotspot plus corona.** The old cone clamped to a flat disc. Now a Gaussian spot sits inside a wide, faint skirt bounded by the bezel. At full zoom the centre is 2.5× brighter and collapses by 5°, then a long shelf of faint light runs out to 40°. Zoom steps are geometric, so every click of the wheel is equally visible.
- **Distance falloff is now inverse-square.** Brightness used to hold up through the middle of the beam and then fall off a cliff. It now decays smoothly over the whole length, modelling a virtual source behind the reflector.
- **Light limit raised from 32 to 128, per-chunk cap removed.** That cap keyed on chunk *columns*, so four flares at different heights already fought for slots.
- **Voxel occluder rebuilt** (the shadow path under Sodium): half-block voxels from real block shapes, bit-packed at one bit per voxel — four times the voxels in a *smaller* texture — and reach raised from 24 to 32 blocks.

## Fixed

- **The beam jumped to the centre of the screen when looking straight down.** The lens offset was built from a cross product with world-up, which degenerates to zero when the view is vertical.
- Emissive render types no longer clone pipelines they cannot use.

## Known limits

- **Shadow maps do not work with Sodium installed.** Sodium renders terrain with its own programs and never fills the vanilla draw list, so there is nothing to re-render from the light's point of view. The improved voxel occluder runs there instead.
- Entity shadows are analytic capsules, not real geometry.

**Requires** Fabric API and Java 25, on Minecraft 26.1.x. Client *and* server.

releases.notes:
Minecraft 26.1.x · Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3

## New
- **Night Vision Goggles** — worn on the head, toggled with **G**. Honest overexposure: daylight, torches and flashlight beams burn out to pale green per-pixel. ~3 s tube warm-up synced to the power-on sound, film grain, 576-line scanline effect. Powered by an AA battery (30 min) with hot-swap on the same key. Craft-only.
- **Signal Flare** — right-click to ignite, thrown in an arc, lands and burns for 60 s. Red point light from the flashlight engine + a column of red smoke. Cannot be extinguished.
- **Sounds** — flashlight click, focus zoom, NVG on/off, work lantern hum (loop). Subtitles in en/ru.
- **Loot & recipes** — flashlight and batteries in villages, work lantern and battery packs in dungeons/mineshafts/strongholds.

## Engine
- **Per-chunk light limit**: at most 4 sources per chunk, global cap raised 16 → 32 — a crowd of flashlights in one spot no longer starves light in neighboring chunks.
- **Faster, softer shadows**: distance-based LOD (5 rays up close, 1 beyond ~25 blocks where the penumbra is subpixel anyway), a two-radius sample disk + interleaved gradient noise instead of a static pattern.
- **Voxel occluder v2**: only slices with actually-changed blocks get rescanned — a static world no longer burns ~14,000 block checks per frame.
- Entity shadows no longer flicker on teleport / dimension change.
- GPU resources and native memory are released when leaving a world.

## Fixes
- A landed flare no longer sinks or jitters for other players (landed state is now synced).
- The reload pose no longer flickers with items in both hands and is frame-rate independent.
- NVG warm-up freezes while the game is paused; no residual blind flash after rejoining a world.
- Creative mode no longer drains charge or consumes batteries.
- Scroll-wheel focus now works for an off-hand flashlight.
- Rate limit on NVG toggle packets (sound anti-grief).
